provenance: SYNTHETIC, AI-JUDGED, NOT INDEPENDENT: twelve simulated author profiles write the v2 sentences (train R1-R6, dev D1-D3, test E1-E3, no profile or scenario group shared between splits); labels are the author's intent, checked by two configurations of one local AI judge and settled by the builder where both judges disagreed with the intent; no person wrote, labelled or reviewed any row. Training also uses the old template set and the v1 synthetic set (already scored, never v2 dev or test). A generalisation check, not evidence about real trainee speech. Hard negatives: the 179 evasive critical sentences of the three tuning adversarial sets and, since the fifth session, the critical_evasive rows of the challenge set v4 (a development set since its third-session scoring) are added to training with their critical act (build_safe_heads.py). Adversarial hold-out 3 and the challenge set v5 are held out of training as the internal validation; the challenge set v6 is frozen and unread.
note: Credit needs the act to be neither NONE nor critical and its probability to reach the threshold; critical acts are recorded, never credited from speech. Deterministic action-based scoring stays authoritative.
